caption: Most weekly plans start with tasks and end with little impact. These five prompts help you diagnose, prioritize, and ship outcomes. What outcome will you ship this week?

slides.title: Outcomes beat task lists
slides.body: Problem: you plan tasks, not outcomes, wasting time. Five prompts will diagnose, reframe, plan, test, and refine your work.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose outcomes
slides.body: Diagnose outcomes. Prompt: Given tasks [INPUT_TASKS], map each to a defined outcome, flag missing outcomes. Output: table: Task, Outcome, Impact(1-5).

slides.title: 2. Reframe priorities
slides.body: Prompt: For each outcome, propose top-priority task; drop non-critical tasks. Output: ordered list by impact, with new deadlines.

slides.title: 3. Apply constraints
slides.body: Prompt: Given outcomes and capacity [CAPACITY], assign tasks into weekly blocks; cap hours per week; ensure coverage.

slides.title: 4. Check realism
slides.body: Prompt: Check feasibility by comparing planned vs actual velocity last 2 weeks; flag overcommitments; adjust plan.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Prompt: Produce a reusable weekly brief: objectives, top 3 tasks, success metrics, owners, deadlines; export as checklist.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Outcome-first planning saves time and aligns work with impact; use these prompts to ship outcomes, not busywork.
